title: Remote viewing by becoming the object (awareness-shifting training)
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: there was a lot of subconscious uh training to basically help me understand that my awareness could become the door. I could become the room. I could become the filing cabinet where the documents are in and then extract the information that way.

plain: Between 2008 and 2010, at Baker Victory Services, a care centre in Western New York, a boy was trained to send his awareness into a place and become it: the room, or the filing cabinet that held the documents, so he could pull out the information inside. The boy was Jordan Jose, who tells it himself as a grown witness. He says much of the training worked on his subconscious, to teach him that "my awareness could become the door", and he names a woman called Meg in connection with it. If true, children were being trained in remote viewing, the practice of trying to sense distant places with the mind alone.
